description: This video demonstrates a Parkinsonian-like gait pattern.  This pattern can be secondary to Parkinsons Disease, but also other conditions.  The patient has difficulty initiating movement and has a slow, stooped gait, with very little clearance of their feet from the floor.  The classic description is a shuffling, stooped gait.
